body: Observed experimental developer friction using installed Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build163: twelve related contracts for six-workflow integration exceed OCM aggregate bound128, while each prepares. title: Dogfood multi-intent aggregation needs actionable guidance at the 128-obligation bound
